text:
jess: Heads up — nightly kernel-validator run flagged a 12% p95 regression for the tiled_gemm_v2 kernel on AVX2 for seqlen=2048 :eyes:

samir: ugh. which job/artifact? link?

jess: perf-bot posted summary: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/451/artifacts/bench-1923456789/summary.html

mike: I pulled the raw microbench. Looks like throughput per-core drops when batch_size=1 and seqlen>1024. KV cache hit rate is fine, so probably a kernel asm path switch going wrong.

anya: can you dump the selected kernel path for failing cases? I want the autotuner trace + chosen codegen flags.

jess: pasted below (small snippet):
```
# autotune decision snippet
model: llama-v2-7b
seqlen: 2048
batch: 1
hw: avx2
selected_kernel: tiled_gemm_v2
picked_tile: 32x32
vectorize: true
use_prefetch: false
```

lisa: I remember we landed a change last week that changes fallback thresholds for small batch low-batch throughput to prefer winograd on avx2. Could be related.

samir: Noted. Two quick follow-ups: 1) can we repro locally with the nightly harness using the same env (gcc/clang/isa)? 2) add a focused microprobe that exercises the 32x32 tile with seqlen=2048 and batch=1 so CI can isolate.

mike: Trying local repro now — running: `./bench/run_microprobe --kernel tiled_gemm_v2 --tile 32 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --arch avx2`

perf-bot: nightly-run: kernel-validator #451 completed — regressions: 1 (p95 12%) — details: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/451/artifacts/bench-1923456789/summary.html :rotating_light:

anya: If local repro fails, we should add a temporary canary job that pins the old autotune table and compare. I can land a small patch to the harness to run both tables side-by-side.

jess: good plan. Also we should capture CPU counters (L1d misses, stalls) during the probe to confirm whether it's a memory/latency issue vs compute. I'll add perf events to the microprobe.

samir: One more ask: add an explicit KV-cache-warmup stage in the harness before measuring for long seqlen to avoid startup noise. We had flakiness from cache cold-start before.

mike: added patch: `bench/harness/longseq_warmup.patch` — warms with 4 prefix steps. Running CI in my fork now.

lisa: If this reproduces, we should mark the autotune candidate as "suspect" and gate it until we determine cause. Also create a retro ticket linking to the nightly artifact.

jess: created ticket RW-3241 with links and initial triage notes.

perf-bot: CI artifact uploaded: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/451/artifacts/bench-1923456789/probe_dump.tar.gz

anya: Next actions: (1) local repro + perf counters (mike) (2) side-by-side autotune compare in harness (anya) (3) block candidate in CI if reproduced (samir) (4) doc short-term mitigation (jess).

samir: I'll prepare the CI block rule — can auto-fail PRs that change kernel-table entries until RW-3241 is resolved.

mike: repro succeeded locally. L1d misses spike ~3x during the 32x32 path with seqlen 2048. Looks like prefetching disabled on that codegen variant. Adding a quick patch to enable prefetch for tiled_gemm_v2 on avx2 reduces p95 by ~10% locally. I'll push bench results in a minute.

jess: that's promising. Once you push, I'll re-run the nightly harness and watch for delta. Please include the microbench command + env matrix in the PR so perf reviewers can reproduce.

mike: pushed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/commit/ab12c3f — includes prefetch toggle + perf counters. Results: p50 unchanged, p95 down by 9-11% across runs.

anya: great. I'll add the side-by-side autotune run to the nightly harness tomorrow and mark a follow-up to run the nightly sweep across GPUs (h100/avx2/avx512).

lisa: can we add a short note in the kernel-validator README about how to triage these kinds of regressions? A checklist would help oncall.

jess: added checklist item in RW-3241: "check autotune decisions, run microprobe with perf counters, warm kv cache, compare candidate table side-by-side".

samir: thanks team. Let's keep the CI flagged until the side-by-side confirms the fix. :zap:

perf-bot: note: nightly-run scheduler will re-run candidate tests in ~6h.

jess: closing loop here later. If anyone sees other regressions in related kernels (winograd/tiled_gemm_v1) please tag this thread.

mike: FYI the microprobe snippet I used for others:```
./bench/run_microprobe --kernel tiled_gemm_v2 --tile 32 --seq 2048 --batch 1 --arch avx2 --warmup 4 --perf-events L1-dcache-loads,LLC-load-misses,stalls
```

anya: saved. docs later. good work. :thumbsup:
